import pickle
genetic_code = pickle.load(open("C:/Users/VivaA/2214/IntroBiolComp-2026/Python/genetic_code.pickle", "rb"))

test_mRNA = "AUGGAAUUCUCGCUCUGAAGGUAA"

def get_amino_acids(mRNA):
    i = 0
    aa_sequence = []
    while (i + 3) < len(mRNA):
        codon = mRNA[i:(i + 3)]
        aa = genetic_code[codon]
        if aa == "Stop":
            break
        else:
            aa_sequence.append(aa)
        i = i + 3
    return "".join(aa_sequence)

print(get_amino_acids(test_mRNA))

import pickle
with open("C:/Users/VivaA/2214/IntroBiolComp-2026/Python/genetic_code.pickle", "rb") as f:
    genetic_code = pickle.load(f)
def get_amino_acids(mRNA_string):
    aa_sequence = []
    i = 0
    while (i + 3) <= len(mRNA_string):
        codon = mRNA_string[i: (i + 3)]
        aa = genetic_code.get(codon, "*")
        if aa == "Stop":
            aa_sequence.append("*")
        else:
            aa_sequence.append(aa)
        i = i + 3
    return "".join(aa_sequence)

with open("C:/Users/VivaA/2214/IntroBiolComp-2026/Python/DataFiles/Turkey_transcripts_15.fasta", "r") as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
print("Translation Results:")
for i in range(0, len(lines), 2):
    header = lines[i].strip()
    sequence = lines[i + 1].strip()
    
    Turkey_rna = sequence.replace("T", "U")
    Turkey_protein = get_amino_acids(Turkey_rna)

print(f"Header: {Turkey_protein}")
